what: White cards·sections sit tilted 8° around the top-left corner and transparent. Once the top edge crosses the 5/6 (83.3%) line from the top of the screen, they stand upright and appear with 1s cubic-bezier(.26,.04,.18,.98) (once). An about section where white cards hang one by one on a green background and drop into place

options.tilt: Initial tilt (degrees), default 8 — negative reverses direction
options.delay: Time from crossing the line to start (sec), default 0
options.--fx-origin: Rotation axis (via style), default left top

from.where: about.html six More cards (section.sec-motto — rotate 8deg → 0, opacity 0 → 1, 1s cubic-bezier(.26,.04,.18,.98), transform-origin left top, scroll position > Element top − viewport height + viewport height/6)
